build_service_class: build a protocol service class at runtime using GeneratedServiceType metaclass and a ServiceDescriptor
build_service_stub_class: build a protocol service stub class at runtime using GeneratedServiceStubType metaclass and a ServiceDescriptor
call_method_on_service: call a service method via CallMethod with an rpc_controller, request message, and callback
get_request_class: get the request protocol message class for a given method descriptor using GetRequestClass
get_response_class: get the response protocol message class for a given method descriptor using GetResponseClass
